title: Parts of the Water Transportation System

instruction.text: Label all the parts of this plant correctly.

feedback.correct: The leaves are where the plant carries out photosynthesis.
The stem connects the roots to the leaves and gives the plant support.
The roots anchor the plant into the ground and absorb water and nutrients from the soil.
Tiny root hairs allow the plant to absorb as much water as possible.
Tubes transport water from the roots, through the stem to the leaves.
